capabilities: Manage CRM deals, contacts, companies, and activities with kanban pipeline and dashboards
Plan projects with milestones, tasks, and autosaving section editors
Capture reminders with repeat options and in-app or desktop notifications
Import entities from CSV with automatic column mapping
Generate reports over pipeline, sales, partners, and daily-note productivity
disambiguation: Not just a daily planner or calendar; it bundles CRM, partner management, and project management alongside the planner.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A companion Cadence theme is available separately. Optional sync to a Cadence web instance is on the roadmap.
motivation: The author found that most second-brain plugins do one thing well and wanted a coherent workspace covering the surfaces a working person moves between daily.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in surfaces for CRM pipelines, partner tracking, or project management, so users must assemble several separate plugins for work life.

relations.evidence: Cadence natively integrates with the popular TaskNotes community plugin.
Optional "open on Obsidian startup" + Homepage plugin compatible.

summary: All-in-one workspace plugin that combines CRM, partner management, project planning, daily planning, reminders, and CSV import over plain markdown files.
